arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ، [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُنُّونَ].
transliteration: Allahumma laa tu'aakhithnee bimaa yaqooloon, waghfir lee maa laa ya'lamoon, [waj'alnee khayran mimmaa yathunnoon].
translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say, and forgive me for what they do not know, [and make me better than what they think of me].
